RECOMMENDATION: RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-male panel is worth questioning as a recruitment-process concern, but it does not establish that sex influenced the decision. Your longer experience is relevant; his digital expertise could legitimately outweigh it, depending on the advertised criteria.

Follow up in writing now. Request the selection criteria, how your application was assessed against them, and any policy on panel composition. Frame the panel question neutrally rather than alleging discrimination.

Neither the appointment nor the two-week silence proves bias. If the explanation reveals inconsistent criteria or unequal treatment, consult your union or a local equality adviser promptly: complaint deadlines vary by jurisdiction.
